reviews.reason: Table code and authenticated workspace select the server query and scope search, page and sharing state. They can change outside any table click. A share target must also match the current table and workspace at render time; the workspace-switch test rejects a late link result.

The 300ms timer commits the trimmed server filter together with page 1; its cleanup cancels superseded input. A separate effect clears table-scoped search, page and share state when the workspace or table changes. The server search/sort and pending-share workspace-switch scenarios exercise these independent boundaries.
